headline: A Fidelity International investment strategist said the global economy would be in recession without the spending of the big AI cloud companies, Investment Week reports.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: unverified, only the headline and page description could be read.
importance_line: The claim, if right, would mean ordinary economic growth leans heavily on a few companies' AI spending; it is one strategist's view and we could not read the argument behind it.
summary: Investment Week reports that Fidelity International's Salman Ahmed said weakness in the global economy has been hidden by the large capital spending of the biggest AI cloud companies, without which the world would be in recession.
notes: Paywalled (Enterprise sign-in page); only the headline and the page description were readable. No other outlet found. Headline only; score lowered by 1 as unverified.
